title: Lock a project across apps
responsibility: Allows one agent or planning write per checkout across the local Web and Electron processes.

inputs.name: repositoryLease.root
inputs.description: Canonical local repository root to reserve across Harness app processes.

outputs.name: repositoryLease
outputs.description: An async release callback with an abort signal, or null while another owner holds the repository. Always release in finally.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Refuses unsupported platforms, unreadable lock owners or filesystem failures instead of running without a lock.
examples: Cross-app repository locking is not supported on this platform.
